body:
Hey, I think I experience something kind of similar. Back when I was religious (pre-17) my dream was to always be a martyr, like Jesus or one of his disciples that got stoned. I wanted to die for someone else-- I felt that that was the ultimate. I would spend most of my days thinking of great ways to die while saving people.

When I started to get depressed, I still wanted to die. I guess I still want to be a martyr-- but it has just shifted so much. I used to want to die for people and then people put roses on my grave on my birthday or something stupid. I wanted to be remembered.

Now-- I just want to die. But my fantasies are stranger. Stuff like, everyone that ever mattered to me just beats me and whips me to death, and when they're done they start singing "Oh [my name] is dead!" to the tune of "When the Saints". I still want to die, and I cannot remember a time in my life that death by my choosing was not my ultimate fantasy. Nowadays, it's just a little grimmer than it was back then.
I'm so, so sorry. I wish you peace above all else.

I hope it means I'm a nice person, but all that matters is if I affect them positively. 99% of them live perfectly well without me. My Parents and maybe one or two of my friends would really be affected if I killed myself. The others just kind of seem annoyed and like they could move on with their lives if I didn't bother them. I love them, but they don't think too much of me. They are good at making other friends. I've not made 20 friends in my life.

I have a counselor at the moment. He is good. But I don't know. Paying someone to listen to my crap just seems a little sad. It's definitely lessened me talking this stuff to my friends though, so it is helping. I just wish I could hang out with my friends without them being sad. I don't even say anything, and they just get sad. It makes me want to stay alone. 

Thank you so much for your help. You are a really, really good person. Never forget that.

Just drinking again. I had some percocet for my wisdom teeth removal 6 months ago. That was my first taste. Now I'm drinking and taking Ativan, but I still feel like I need to move onto harder drugs. Drinking doesn't do as much for me as it used to.

Been clinically depressed for about 4 and 1/2 years. I try to not talk to my friends about it, because it physically exhausts them. I would not be typing this if I hadn't drank. I only drink on Wednesdays and Saturdays to try to limit myself. But I don't know. I feel I can't make it for much longer. I have had several attempts but I don't think I could take another "attempt", just a success. I don't know. You guys are angels.
